content:
These subscription plans apply only to PLAN_BANK obligations. TARIFF_BANK obligations use the separate tariffs and rebates policies.

CORE STANDARD charges 40 basis points with a 100-cent minimum per payment and no activation charge. PRO charges 10 basis points with a 100-cent minimum, costs 2000 cents to activate and becomes active after 30 minutes.

SHARED charges 15 basis points with a 200-cent minimum, no activation fee, and activates after 5 minutes. These amounts use USD cents.

Percentage charges round upward to the next cent. inspect_plan_charge quotes the selected invoice using the currently effective subscription.

Each obligation explicitly lists accepted_payment_methods. BANK, AUTHORIZED_BANK, PLAN_BANK and CARD are distinct recipient instructions.

A bank-only invoice cannot be paid as a card merchant purchase; an operator-authorized or plan-priced obligation must use its declared method.
